address_rule: Retain every strict field match. For a mismatched address string, compare both sides after replacing each LF newline with comma-space and collapsing whitespace. Accept only exact equality of these canonical strings. Retain all other characters, digits, case, punctuation, and component order. This is a narrow formatting equivalence, not general semantic address matching.
attribution: Offline metric revision on the same saved responses. This is a change in measurement, not a model or prompt improvement or proof of production migration readiness.
complete_document_success: Response status is completed, original JSON/schema checks pass, and every field matches under its existing rule or the additional address rule. All planned observations remain in the denominator.
cost: Retain metered spend including all attempts; divide by strict and normalized successful-document counts separately. Token, timing, attempt and total-spend records remain unchanged.
evidence: Original measurement artifacts and the full source-to-release audit trail are retained in the internal review record. This package verifies the shipped aggregate files and regenerates reports; it does not reproduce individual inference calls or per-case grading.
paired_statistics: Use matched task outcomes, exact two-sided McNemar p-values, and a deterministic stratified task bootstrap with 10000 resamples. Apply Holm within each three-model comparison family and scoring rule. Preserve GPT-4.1 versus none and low versus high as separate comparison families. None versus high is descriptive across runs with timing/output-ceiling differences.
scope: Apply the same rule to all 192 saved evaluation documents in each of 10 saved model/effort conditions: GPT-4.1 omitted and GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra/Sol none/low/high. All 110 other workload/model/effort cells retain v1.0.0 corrected scores.
strict_baseline: v1.0.0 corrected invoice references; strict scoring collapses whitespace, normalizes currency case, and compares money at cent precision.
validation: Validate original JSON and schema before applying address equivalence. No JSON repair, missing-field insertion, type coercion, case folding, abbreviation expansion, punctuation deletion, or fuzzy matching is added.
